set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: L01.5
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Product/backend/frontend engineer with local operator
Scope: Prove that the demonstrable product is repeatable and survives expected workstation failures.

Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: L01 (bd-01M4X5M9Y1A8NCC8SRECRA62AE)
Suggested delivery tranche: T5; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Run the full browser story successfully from three fresh local roots using the same pinned artifact/seed, recording actual machine, versions and timings.
2. Exercise warm service/database restart, interrupted intake/export and database unavailability; accepted identities/bytes remain correct, incomplete work cannot claim completion and retries cannot duplicate acceptance.
3. Exercise revoked/stale accounts and hidden names/counts during the rehearsals; retain redacted logs and automated keyboard/accessibility evidence with explicit human/institutional gaps.

Verification: Repeatable local qualification runner and retained three-run plus failure-case receipts with independent catalog and byte assertions.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/L01.5/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

Source/contracts:
- docs/local-demo-plan.md
- docs/service-distribution.md
- docs/decisions/001-institutional-organization.md
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- L01.4: bd-01M4X5MABQ32PFAAKMZQ4FJKNG
- H01: bd-01M4X8M9386WG7Z2RW1J2C2RBB
- H02: bd-01M4X8M986VW0MMZ2S4AQDC58C
- H03: bd-01M4X8M9CTMTKZHBKG8T9E8EDS
- H04: bd-01M4X8M9GWYPFKAAZVHK760RSN
- H05: bd-01M4X8M9N0FV6ANAHVQ147KJNE
- H06: bd-01M4X8M9S1X431HCYR55D69QA5

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: L01.5: Qualify repeated local demo installation and failure recovery
